meta.title: Awesome Laravel AI
meta.tagline: Actively maintained packages for building AI features, agents, and MCP servers in Laravel.

categories.title: Multi-Provider Abstractions
categories.blurb: One API across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama and the rest. Start here if you would rather not be locked to a single vendor.

categories.title: Provider SDKs and Clients
categories.blurb: Thin, direct clients for when you only target one provider and want its full surface area.

categories.title: Model Context Protocol
categories.blurb: Expose your Laravel app as tools an agent can call, or consume MCP servers from inside your app.

categories.title: Agents and Orchestration
categories.blurb: Multi-step reasoning, tool calling, memory, and background agent runs.

categories.title: RAG, Vectors and Embeddings
categories.blurb: Chunking, embedding, storage and retrieval over your own application data.

categories.title: AI-Assisted Development
categories.blurb: Packages that make coding agents measurably better at working on Laravel codebases.

categories.title: Evaluation and Observability
categories.blurb: Know whether your AI feature works, and what it costs, before your users tell you.

categories.title: Token Optimization
categories.blurb: Fit more context into fewer tokens.

categories.title: Content and Discoverability
categories.blurb: Making a Laravel app legible to crawlers and answer engines.

categories.title: Utilities
categories.blurb: Focused single-purpose tools that did not fit anywhere else.

packages.summary: The de facto standard. Unified text generation, structured output, embeddings and tool calling across every major provider, with a fluent Laravel-native API.
Full generative AI toolkit for PHP: chat, embeddings, vector stores and question answering. Framework agnostic with Laravel bindings.
Structured output done properly. Define a PHP class, get back a validated instance instead of hand-parsing JSON out of a string.
Official Laravel SDK for Neuron, covering agents, RAG and workflows behind one interface.
OpenRouter integration, which gets you several hundred models through a single credential.
The most widely installed AI package in the Laravel world. Facade, config publishing and full OpenAI API coverage.
The framework-agnostic core that the Laravel adapter wraps. Use it directly outside Laravel.
Gemini for Laravel from the same team behind the OpenAI client, so the API shape will feel familiar.
Talk to locally hosted models through Ollama. The obvious starting point if you want inference that never leaves your machine.
Official Anthropic PHP SDK for the Claude API.
Laravel integration for Anthropic: facade, config publishing and streaming.
Community Claude SDK with a Laravel service provider.
Community-driven DeepSeek client, useful when cost per token is the deciding factor.
The Laravel service provider for the DeepSeek client above.
First-party MCP server support from the Laravel core team. Routes, tools, resources and prompts declared the way you would declare anything else in Laravel.
Mature independent SDK. Attribute-driven tool discovery and multiple transports. Predates the official package and still ships features it lacks.
Production-oriented server built around secure remote transports rather than stdio.
MCP server that exposes Eloquent models and app actions with an auth layer in front of them.
Puts Telescope entries in front of an agent so it can read your queries and exceptions while debugging.
Zero-config browser UI and MCP server for exploring Eloquent models and their relationships.
Deliberately read-only. A sane default when you want an agent to inspect production without being able to touch it.
The other direction: consume any configured MCP server from inside your Laravel app.
Exposes Filament resources over MCP.
Agents as Laravel classes. Chat history, tools and per-agent configuration with very little ceremony.
Task orchestrator with routing, queueing, budget caps and audit logging. Worth reading before you build your own.
Agents that execute application actions behind an explicit permission model.
Driver-based end to end RAG pipeline: ingest, chunk, embed, retrieve.
pgvector driver for Laravel Scout. If you already run Postgres, this is the shortest path to semantic search.
Fluent Qdrant client for when you outgrow a table with a vector column.
Strategy-based text chunking. Chunk quality decides retrieval quality, so this matters more than it looks.
Native MariaDB 11.7+ vector columns through Eloquent, with no extra service to run.
Cloudflare Vectorize driver for Laravel Scout.
Related content links built from pgvector embeddings.
Persistent agent memory with semantic search and reranking.
First-party. Feeds coding agents accurate, version-specific Laravel context plus app introspection tools. Install this before blaming the model.
Spatie house style as Boost guidelines, so generated code matches how the ecosystem actually writes Laravel.
The same guidelines packaged as portable agent skills.
Visual feedback loop so a coding agent can see the page it just changed.
Agent definitions tuned for the TALL stack.
Spec-driven workflow: discovery, backlog and planning before any code gets generated.
Agent skills aimed specifically at people authoring Laravel packages.
Read-only context tools plus an evidence-based audit methodology for reviewing an unfamiliar codebase.
Versioned, file-based prompt management. Treats prompts as reviewable artifacts instead of strings buried in a controller.
Evals as Pest tests. LLM-as-judge and semantic assertions running in the same suite as everything else.
Golden dataset harness for RAG and LLM pipelines.
Lightweight eval runner for AI features.
Observability for LLM calls: traces, token counts and spend, inside your own app.
Token-Oriented Object Notation. Noticeably cheaper than JSON when you are stuffing structured data into a prompt.
TOON encoder and decoder wired into Laravel.
PHP tiktoken port. Count tokens before you send them, not after the invoice arrives.
Counts the tokens a prompt will cost across several model families.
Generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt so crawlers get a clean map of your site.
Generative engine optimization helpers for getting products surfaced inside AI answers.
Filament-native publishing that emits AI-citable article markup.
Modular AI translation gateway for Laravel language files.
Drops an AI copilot panel into a Filament admin.
Laravel-native chatbot built on the OpenAI Responses API.
MCP server for Statamic v6, if your Laravel app happens to be a Statamic site.
